text:
mike_sec: Quick sync: RedTeamCo asked for decrypt capability on a subset of artifacts for validation. We should avoid handing them KMS Decrypt directly. Proposal: vendor does client-side envelope encryption with a proxied encrypted envelope key from our kms-proxy; we only issue GenerateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext/Encrypt flow. Thoughts?

nisha_sre: +1 no direct Decrypt. KMS-proxy can return an encrypted envelope key that the vendor unwraps with their ephemeral key. We need to record GenerateDataKey/Encrypt calls in audit logs.

leo_engineer: For uploads, two options: presigned PUT with bucket policy + object tags OR short-lived IAM role with PutObject. Prefer role because we can scope kms:Encrypt and add condition: aws:SourceIp and aws:RequestTag/upload-run-id.

claire_compliance: Compliance prefers tags in manifest for chain-of-custody. If using role, ensure tagging enforced and manifest includes uploader identity, timestamp, sha256. Also need an RBAC table showing who can approve post-window escalation.

mike_sec: Ok action items:
- nisha_sre: create ephemeral role pt-external-upload (expires 6h) with s3:PutObject, kms:Encrypt; add condition keys for aws:RequestTag/upload-run-id and aws:SourceIp (vendor ranges).
- leo_engineer: manifest generator in lambda, write to s3://pt-evidence/staging/{run_id}/manifest.json. Include sha256, uploader (role session name), object_key, upload_ts.
- claire_compliance: draft RBAC escalation matrix for review.

nisha_sre: I'll also enable CloudTrail Insights for kms-proxy and S3 data events for the bucket. We'll create a CloudWatch dashboard and an alert: if GenerateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext or Encrypt spikes >100/5m, page SRE.

leo_engineer: Presigned helper (if needed) snippet I mocked for vendor SDK: 
```
# server side issue presigned
aws s3 presign put-object --bucket pt-evidence --key staging/${run_id}/${file} --expires-in 3600 --region us-west-2
```
But presigned can't enforce request tags reliably across all clients; role is stronger.

claire_compliance: For audit exports: sample 5% of upload events to SIEM in real-time and ship full manifest after window closure. Also ask legal: need NDA copy attached to manifest? I'll check.

mike_sec: Re test slots: vendor asked for retest next Wednesday afternoon. Propose Wed 13:00-17:00 PT reserve. Who triages?

nisha_sre: I'll be primary triage for infra-level issues. leo_engineer for app-level vuln triage. Add JIRA epic PT-459 and link sprint ticket.

deploy-bot: Scheduled maintenance: kms-proxy v2.4 rollout Wed 09:00 PT, canary 20m. Will update channel when canary passes.

mike_sec: Recap owners and deadlines: nisha (ephemeral role + alerts) by EOD today; leo (manifest + lambda) by EOD; claire (RBAC matrix + compliance checks) by tomorrow noon. Reserve retest Wed 13:00-17:00 PT. If blocked, escalate to #eng-sre and #product-security. :white_check_mark:

leo_engineer: added presigned vs role decision note to RED-PT-459. Will include example log queries for CloudWatch and SIEM mapping.

nisha_sre: role ARN to be posted once created. I'll also add temporary policy statement with kms:Encrypt and kms:GenerateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext only, no kms:Decrypt.

mike_sec: Thanks team. Closing thread and moving tasks into PT-459. (reacts: :lock: :scroll:)
